text:
maya: heads-up: planning a quiet-burn canary for rwd-v5.2-int4 tomorrow 06:00 UTC. primary concern: longdoc slice quality and p95 tail. sharing preliminary numbers and proposed gates.

sam: curious about the A/B slice breakouts from your dev run?

maya: dev smoke (3k queries): cost ~0.45x, avg latency +20ms, p95 +95ms on >1024 tokens, QA F1 delta -0.9% on longdoc, hallucination alerts +2.4pp. shortanswers and code slices look within noise.

kevin: looks like KV misses on cross-turns are the likely cause for p95. I can try a runtime warmup tweak to prefill KV for sessions in the burn.

dena: proposing route-aware auto-fallbacks: thresholds per-route instead of global. defaults: f1_delta_pct = -1.5, halluc_pp_delta = +5.0, p95_ms_delta = +220. Action: immediate route switch to last-stable (v5.1 fp16) + incident alert. Also soft-hold if any metric deviates >0.5% for 45m.

liz: +1 on per-route. also recommend quiet-burn settings: step0 at 0.5% with telemetry suppressed on main SLA dashboards for first 60m (so dev-alerting only), then full visibility on subsequent steps. staged ramp: 0.5% -> 3% -> 10% with 30-60m holds.

maya: I wrote a quick rollout snippet for console (pseudo-yaml):
```
rollout:
  steps: [0.005, 0.03, 0.10]
  quiet_burn_minutes: 60
  hold_minutes: 30
  per_route_metrics:
    longdoc:
      qa_f1_threshold: -1.5
      halluc_pp_threshold: 5.0
      p95_ms_threshold: 220
    default:
      qa_f1_threshold: -1.5
      halluc_pp_threshold: 5.0
      p95_ms_threshold: 250
  auto_fallback: true
```

canary-bot: smoke summary (500 samples): cost 0.46x, avg latency +28ms, p95 +102ms, longdoc QA F1: 72.4 -> 71.6 (-0.8%), hallucination: 1.8% -> 4.2% (+2.4pp).

sam: OK. I suggest we run a 2h quiet 0.5% burn (not 30m) to get better hallucination signal. I'll collect slice diffs and top-3 rerank disagreement (add rerank-guard: escalate if top-3 disagreement >5%).

kevin: I'll land the KV warmup flag tonight behind a runtime toggle. If p95 spikes we can flip warmup on for the canary routes.

dena: clarifying auto-fallback behavior: fallback is route-scoped and immediate for that route only. Also add an "escalate_on_repeat" rule: if same route triggers auto-fallback >2x within 24h, create a P1.

maya: noted. liz: can you draft the targeted eval set for longdoc so we can run it automatically if soft-hold triggers?

liz: will do. primary evals: Q/A fidelity, citation hallucination heuristic, and summary faithfulness. will hand off prompt set and example diffs.

sam: timeline: run 2h quiet-burn at 06:00 UTC, share A/B slice diffs + rerank and hallucination logs. if within thresholds proceed with staged ramp.

maya: thanks. will post results in this thread. also leaving the quiet-burn toggle accessible to oncall and SEs: console link https://internal.redwood/console/rollouts/1725432100

kevin: FYI I'll also monitor GPU utilization — quant variant has different memory pressure. might need to bump instance class if OOM risk appears.

dena: reminder: ensure runbook https://internal.redwood/runbooks/canary-rollback is up-to-date and the canary-bot alert channel is #incidents.

maya: done. big thanks everyone. will update thread with smoke -> 0.5% quiet-burn results. :rocket:
